ex.en: He put his things carelessly in the drawer.
ex.zh: 他隨手把東西丟進抽屜。

ex.en: All the desk drawers were empty.
ex.zh: 所有書桌抽屜都是空的。

ex.en: I found this in your desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我在你的書桌抽屜裡找到這個。

ex.en: We had a fire drill yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天進行了消防演習。

ex.en: This is only a drill, so please stay calm.
ex.zh: 這只是演習，請保持冷靜。

ex.en: I need a drill to put up this shelf.
ex.zh: 我需要一支電鑽來裝這個架子。

ex.en: The noise from the drill was terrible.
ex.zh: 電鑽的聲音吵死了。

ex.en: They drilled a hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他們在牆上鑽了一個洞。

ex.en: The company is drilling for oil offshore.
ex.zh: 這家公司正在海上鑽探石油。

ex.en: Last year the region was visited by the worst drought in 60 years.
ex.zh: 去年那個地區遭遇了六十年來最嚴重的乾旱。

ex.en: During droughts, farmers are barely able to eke out a living.
ex.zh: 乾旱時期，農民幾乎無法維持生計。

ex.en: What are the advantages and drawbacks of this method?
ex.zh: 這個方法有什麼優點和缺點？

ex.en: The only drawback is the high price.
ex.zh: 唯一的缺點是價格太高。

ex.en: Working from home has some drawbacks.
ex.zh: 在家工作有一些缺點。

ex.en: Jim likes to play the drum.
ex.zh: 吉姆喜歡打鼓。

ex.en: She can play the drum.
ex.zh: 她會打鼓。

ex.en: Tom plays the bongo drums.
ex.zh: 湯姆會打邦哥鼓。

ex.en: The oil was stored in large metal drums.
ex.zh: 石油存放在大型金屬桶裡。

ex.en: Several drums of chemicals were found in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫裡發現好幾桶化學品。

ex.en: She drummed her fingers on the desk.
ex.zh: 她用手指在桌上敲著。

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof all night.
ex.zh: 雨整夜打在屋頂上。

drum.zh: drum up：招攬、爭取（生意、支持）

ex.en: We need to drum up more business this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季我們需要招攬更多生意。

ex.en: The team is trying to drum up support for the project.
ex.zh: 團隊正努力為這個專案爭取支持。

ex.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
ex.zh: 在這段期間，情況有了巨大的變化。

ex.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
ex.zh: 他們壟斷了供應市場，並大幅調漲價格。

ex.en: Sales have dropped drastically this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季的銷售量大幅下滑。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud drifting across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲在天空中飄過。

ex.en: Fluffy white clouds drift across the sky one by one.
ex.zh: 一朵朵蓬鬆的白雲從天空飄過。

drift.zh: 漫無目的地過日子；（關係）漸漸疏遠

ex.en: Many people drift through life without a purpose.
ex.zh: 許多人毫無目標地隨波逐流過日子。

ex.en: Over the years, we drifted apart.
ex.zh: 這些年來，我們漸漸疏遠了。

ex.en: Do you get my drift?
ex.zh: 你懂我的意思嗎？

ex.en: I didn't catch every word, but I got the drift.
ex.zh: 我沒有每個字都聽懂，但大概知道意思。

drain.zh: 排出（液體）、把水放掉、瀝乾

ex.en: Have you drained the bathtub?
ex.zh: 你把浴缸裡的水放掉了嗎？

ex.en: Drain the pasta and add the sauce.
ex.zh: 把義大利麵瀝乾，再加入醬汁。

ex.en: The drains are blocked up.
ex.zh: 排水管堵住了。

ex.en: Don't pour oil down the drain.
ex.zh: 不要把油倒進排水孔。

ex.en: The long meeting completely drained me.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議讓我筋疲力盡。

ex.en: The project is draining our budget.
ex.zh: 這個專案正在耗光我們的預算。

ex.en: He drove the car, listening to music on the radio.
ex.zh: 他一邊開車，一邊聽收音機的音樂。

ex.en: Tom drives his car to work every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天開車上班。

ex.en: It is an hour's drive from here to there.
ex.zh: 從這裡開車到那裡要一個小時。

ex.en: It's a short drive to the airport.
ex.zh: 開車到機場很近。

ex.en: Can you drive me to the station?
ex.zh: 你可以開車載我去車站嗎？

ex.en: My dad drove me to school.
ex.zh: 我爸開車載我去學校。

ex.en: Save the file to the shared drive.
ex.zh: 把檔案存到共用磁碟。

ex.en: My hard drive is almost full.
ex.zh: 我的硬碟快滿了。

ex.en: Strong demand is driving prices up.
ex.zh: 強勁的需求推升了價格。

ex.en: What drives you to work so hard?
ex.zh: 是什麼驅使你這麼努力工作？

ex.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 數學老師在黑板上畫了一個圓。

ex.en: I'm not good at drawing, but I can write.
ex.zh: 我不擅長畫畫，但我會寫作。

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這個展覽吸引了大眾很多注意。

ex.en: The festival draws thousands of visitors every year.
ex.zh: 這個節慶每年吸引數千名遊客。

ex.en: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.
ex.zh: 我們抽籤決定誰先吧。

ex.en: The winners will be drawn next Friday.
ex.zh: 得獎者將於下週五抽出。

ex.en: Please draw the curtains.
ex.zh: 請把窗簾拉上。

ex.en: I need to draw some money from the bank.
ex.zh: 我需要從銀行領一些錢。

ex.en: The match ended in a draw.
ex.zh: 比賽以平手收場。

ex.en: It was a 1–1 draw.
ex.zh: 比賽一比一平手。

ex.en: I dropped my phone on the floor.
ex.zh: 我把手機掉到地上了。

ex.en: Be careful not to drop the glasses.
ex.zh: 小心別把杯子摔了。

ex.en: I think the wind's dropping off.
ex.zh: 我覺得風變小了。

ex.en: Prices dropped sharply last month.
ex.zh: 上個月價格大幅下跌。

ex.en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.
ex.zh: 我感覺有一滴雨落在頭上。

ex.en: A pool begins with many drops of water.
ex.zh: 一池水是由許多水滴匯聚而成的。

ex.en: If you have time, please drop in on us.
ex.zh: 你有空就來我們家坐坐吧。

ex.en: Feel free to drop by my office anytime.
ex.zh: 隨時歡迎來我辦公室坐坐。

ex.en: Yanni dropped the PC off at the repair shop.
ex.zh: 雅尼把電腦送去維修店。

ex.en: Can you drop me off at the station?
ex.zh: 你可以載我到車站讓我下車嗎？

ex.en: I am not used to drinking coffee without sugar.
ex.zh: 我不習慣喝不加糖的咖啡。

ex.en: You should drink more water every day.
ex.zh: 你每天應該多喝水。

ex.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
ex.zh: 你尤其不該空腹喝酒。

ex.en: My father used to drink till late at night.
ex.zh: 我父親以前常喝酒喝到深夜。

ex.en: Tom told me that he doesn't like carbonated drinks.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我說他不喜歡碳酸飲料。

ex.en: Can I get you a drink?
ex.zh: 要不要幫你拿杯喝的？

ex.en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
ex.zh: 服藥時請仔細遵照瓶上的說明。

ex.en: This drug may cause side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能會有副作用。

ex.en: Tom has a long history of drug abuse.
ex.zh: 湯姆有長期濫用藥物的紀錄。

ex.en: Many criminals in America are addicted to drugs.
ex.zh: 美國很多罪犯都有毒癮。

ex.en: She spends most of her money on her dresses.
ex.zh: 她大部分的錢都花在買洋裝上。

ex.en: She went into her room to change her dress.
ex.zh: 她回房間換洋裝。

ex.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
ex.zh: 她買了六碼布來做洋裝。

ex.en: Tom is dressed a little more casually than usual.
ex.zh: 湯姆穿得比平時稍微隨便一點。

ex.en: She aided her daughter in dressing.
ex.zh: 她幫女兒穿衣服。

ex.en: You should dress formally for the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你應該穿得正式一點。

ex.en: What is the dress code for the dinner?
ex.zh: 晚宴的服裝規定是什麼？

ex.en: The office has a casual dress code.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室的服裝規定很休閒。

ex.en: I don't have any money, but I have dreams.
ex.zh: 我沒有錢，但我有夢想。

ex.en: Working abroad has always been my dream.
ex.zh: 到國外工作一直是我的夢想。

ex.en: I had a strange dream last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。

ex.en: Good night and sweet dreams!
ex.zh: 晚安，祝你好夢！

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想成為糕點師傅。

ex.en: I never dreamed that I would win first prize.
ex.zh: 我從沒想過自己會得到頭獎。

ex.en: How could I be a robot? Robots don't dream.
ex.zh: 我怎麼可能是機器人呢？機器人不會做夢。

ex.en: I often dream about my old school.
ex.zh: 我常夢到以前的學校。

ex.en: It has been the driest June for thirty years.
ex.zh: 這是三十年來最乾的六月。

ex.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
ex.zh: 寒冷乾燥、陽光燦爛，多美的冬日天氣！

ex.en: My throat feels dry and raw and scratchy.
ex.zh: 我的喉嚨又乾又痛又癢。

ex.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.
ex.zh: 這是用來烘乾衣服的電器。

ex.en: Please dry your hands with this towel.
ex.zh: 請用這條毛巾擦乾你的手。

ex.en: The lecture was long and dry.
ex.zh: 這場演講又長又枯燥。

ex.en: The report is accurate but a bit dry.
ex.zh: 這份報告很準確，但有點枯燥。

ex.en: Some of the drivers were laughing and yelling.
ex.zh: 有些司機又笑又叫。

ex.en: Drivers must observe the traffic rules.
ex.zh: 駕駛必須遵守交通規則。

ex.en: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你還太小，不能考駕照。

ex.en: You need to update the printer driver.
ex.zh: 你需要更新印表機驅動程式。

ex.en: I downloaded the latest drivers for my graphics card.
ex.zh: 我下載了顯示卡的最新驅動程式。

ex.en: Innovation is a key driver of growth.
ex.zh: 創新是成長的關鍵驅動力。

ex.en: Cost was the main driver behind the decision.
ex.zh: 成本是做這個決定的主要原因。

ex.en: I am writing a draft of the speech.
ex.zh: 我正在寫演講的草稿。

ex.en: Please send me the first draft of the report by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把報告初稿寄給我。

ex.en: My manager asked me to draft a reply to the client.
ex.zh: 我的主管請我草擬給客戶的回信。

ex.en: The lawyer is drafting the new contract.
ex.zh: 律師正在起草新合約。

ex.en: The payment was made by bank draft.
ex.zh: 這筆款項是用銀行匯票支付的。

ex.en: Please enclose a bank draft with your application.
ex.zh: 申請時請附上銀行匯票。

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天喝生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: We don't sell draft beer.
ex.zh: 我們不賣生啤酒。

ex.en: There has been a dramatic increase in online sales.
ex.zh: 網路銷售大幅成長。

ex.en: The city has seen dramatic changes in recent years.
ex.zh: 這座城市近年來變化很大。

ex.en: Don't be so dramatic; it's just a small mistake.
ex.zh: 別那麼誇張，只是個小錯誤。

ex.en: The movie has a dramatic ending.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局很戲劇性。

ex.en: The new TV drama is quite interesting.
ex.zh: 這部新電視劇相當有趣。

ex.en: Do you watch Korean dramas?
ex.zh: 你看韓劇嗎？

ex.en: Which drama series do you like best?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪一部電視劇？

ex.en: I don't want any drama at work.
ex.zh: 我不想在工作上有任何風波。

ex.en: There was a lot of drama at the meeting yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天的會議上鬧得很不愉快。

ex.en: Tom dragged himself out of bed and put on his clothes.
ex.zh: 湯姆拖著身子下了床，穿上衣服。

ex.en: He dragged the heavy box across the floor.
ex.zh: 他把那個重箱子拖過地板。

ex.en: Drag the file into this folder.
ex.zh: 把檔案拖曳到這個資料夾裡。

ex.en: You can drag and drop photos here.
ex.zh: 你可以把照片拖放到這裡。

ex.en: The long meeting was a real drag.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議真是無聊透頂。

ex.en: High costs are a drag on our growth.
ex.zh: 高成本拖累了我們的成長。

ex.en: Sales have increased dramatically this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售額大幅成長。

ex.en: Prices dropped dramatically after the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期過後價格大幅下跌。

ex.en: The city has changed dramatically in ten years.
ex.zh: 這座城市十年來變化很大。

ex.en: She sighed dramatically and left the room.
ex.zh: 她誇張地嘆了口氣，離開了房間。

ex.en: He paused dramatically before announcing the winner.
ex.zh: 他在宣布得獎者之前刻意停頓了一下。

ex.en: I like drizzles, not rainstorms.
ex.zh: 我喜歡毛毛雨，不喜歡暴雨。

ex.en: There will be light drizzle in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上會有零星毛毛雨。

ex.en: It's drizzling outside, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 外面在下毛毛雨，帶把傘吧。

ex.en: Drizzle some honey over the pancakes.
ex.zh: 在鬆餅上淋一點蜂蜜。
